title: Distordia Namespace Attestation Standard (v0.2.0 draft)
description: Successor draft to namespace.v0.1.0. Realigned to NATIVE Nexus Names & Namespaces. Nexus already provides a globally-unique, transferable namespace object register protected by a 1000 NXS anti-squatting fee; v0.1.0 re-implemented that as an unenforced string field. This version makes the asset a pure ATTESTATION bound to the native namespace register (ns-addr / ns-owner), fixes the namespace character pattern (Nexus forbids hyphens), replaces the ad-hoc delegation-chain with native namespaced names, and invalidates the attestation on namespace transfer. See docs/namespace-nexus-alignment-note.md.
maxSize: 1KB (system fields ~180 bytes, ~820 bytes for data). Budget: a typical attested organization record lands ~760 bytes; the worst case (every optional string at maxlength) exceeds the cap, so description/website/logo-uri are the fields to trim first. ns-owner (64 hex) and attestation-hash (66) are the largest fixed costs.

nativeNexusBinding.principle: The NATIVE Nexus namespace register is the source of truth for existence, uniqueness, and ownership. This asset only adds trust metadata (tier, stake, reputation, legal identity) on top of it. Do not treat the 'namespace' string here as a claim of ownership on its own.

nameCategories.local: user:name (single colon) - scoped to one sigchain, ~1 NXS. Suited to individuals.
nameCategories.namespaced: namespace::name (double colon) - names inside a globally unique namespace. Suited to organizations/enterprises.

nativeNexusBinding.namespaceRegistration: Creating a namespace costs 1000 NXS and is globally unique (explicit anti-squatting cost). This is a real, chain-enforced sybil cost that exists BEFORE any DIST stake.
nativeNexusBinding.characterRules: A Nexus namespace may contain ONLY lowercase letters, numbers, and periods. Hyphens are NOT permitted (stricter than usernames).
nativeNexusBinding.assetNaming: Assets belonging to an attested organization SHOULD be created as names inside its namespace, e.g. 'acmecorp::product.widget2000', so the namespace is the real on-chain grouping and every asset gets a globally resolvable human-readable name.
nativeNexusBinding.delegation: Sub-identities (agents, departments, swarms) are NAMES INSIDE the namespace (e.g. 'acmecorp::logistics.agent01'), not separate 1000 NXS namespaces. Periods make hierarchy native.
nativeNexusBinding.verificationRule: An attestation is valid only if: (1) the native namespace register at 'ns-addr' currently resolves to the namespace string in 'namespace'; (2) that register's owner genesis equals 'ns-owner'; and (3) 'ns-owner' equals this attestation asset's own system 'owner'. If the namespace is transferred, condition (2) fails and the attestation MUST be treated as invalid (status 'transferred') until re-issued to the new owner.

self-addr.description: Queryable copy of this attestation asset's own register address (the auto-assigned 'address' is not filterable in register/list). Stamped post-create.

namespace.description: The native Nexus namespace (or username, per 'name-category') this attestation describes. MUST match the native register at 'ns-addr'. Nexus permits ONLY lowercase letters, numbers, and periods -- hyphens are invalid.

name-category.description: Which native Nexus naming category this identity uses. Organizations/enterprises use a 'namespace' (1000 NXS, globally unique); individuals typically use a 'username' with local names; 'global' is a bare globally-unique name (2000 NXS).

ns-addr.description: Register address of the NATIVE Nexus namespace (or name) object register this attestation is bound to. The binding that makes uniqueness and ownership chain-enforced rather than asserted.

ns-owner.description: Genesis hash that owned the native namespace register at attestation time. If the namespace is later transferred, the current owner will no longer match and the attestation MUST be treated as invalid until re-issued.

status.description: Attestation validity state. 'transferred' means the underlying namespace changed owner and the attestation needs re-issuance; 'revoked' means withdrawn by the attester.

tier.description: Distordia verification tier. Note this is ADDITIONAL to the native 1000 NXS namespace cost already paid to the chain.

stake.description: DIST tokens staked (base units), on top of the native namespace registration fee.

protocols.description: Comma-separated list of activated Distordia protocols.

parent.description: Parent NAMESPACE for a sub-identity. Note that sub-identities are normally names INSIDE the parent namespace (e.g. 'acmecorp::logistics.agent01') and do not need their own namespace registration. Replaces v0.1.0's ad-hoc 'delegation-chain' string. Nexus namespace rules apply: lowercase letters, numbers and periods only (hyphens are INVALID on-chain).

display-name.description: Human-readable display name (may contain any characters, unlike the namespace itself).

logo-uri.description: Logo/avatar location (https / ipfs:// / ar://). Renamed from v0.1.0 'logo-url' to allow content-addressed URIs.

legal-id.description: LEI or company registration number. Issued by a real-world authority -- the irreducible trust edge.

reputation.description: Reputation score (0-1000). NOTE: per the market evaluation this should move to a provenance-bearing, third-party-attested primitive rather than a self-written counter.

attestation-hash.description: Hash of the off-chain attestation evidence (verification proofs) for integrity.

attester.description: Namespace that issued this attestation (usually 'distordia', or a parent namespace for delegated sub-identities). Nexus namespace rules apply: lowercase letters, numbers and periods only (hyphens are INVALID on-chain).

supersedes.description: self-addr of the prior attestation this one replaces (e.g. re-issuance after a namespace transfer).

examples._comment: Verified organization bound to a native Nexus namespace. Note 'acme.corp' uses a period -- hyphens are invalid on Nexus.
Delegated agent: a NAME INSIDE the parent namespace (acme.corp::logistics.agent01), not its own 1000 NXS namespace.

tierDefinitions._comment: Distordia tiers sit ON TOP of the native Nexus cost: a namespace already costs 1000 NXS (globally unique, anti-squatting), and a global name 2000 NXS, before any DIST stake.

nexus.step1CreateNativeNamespace: names/create/namespace name=acme.corp   # 1000 NXS, globally unique, chain-enforced
nexus.verifyBinding: Resolve ns-addr, confirm it is the namespace register for 'namespace', and confirm its current owner == ns-owner == this asset's owner.

notes: CRITICAL FIX vs v0.1.0: the namespace pattern no longer permits hyphens. Nexus namespaces allow ONLY lowercase letters, numbers, and periods, so v0.1.0 examples such as 'acme-corp' were unregistrable on-chain.
Uniqueness and ownership are NOT asserted by this asset -- they are inherited from the native Nexus namespace register via ns-addr/ns-owner.

Namespaces are transferable/sellable on Nexus. Binding to ns-owner means a transfer invalidates the attestation (status 'transferred'), preventing someone from buying a namespace and inheriting its tier, reputation, and legal-id.
v0.1.0's 'delegation-chain' pipe-separated string is dropped: delegation is native (names inside the namespace, e.g. acme.corp::logistics.agent01), with 'parent' retained for the parent namespace.

Assets across the ecosystem SHOULD be created as namespaced names so the namespace is the real grouping and assets are resolvable by human-readable name -- a native lookup path independent of self-addr.

Repo-wide follow-up: namespace-valued fields in other standards (mfr, steward, supplier, author, driver, passenger, creator, namespace) still use hyphenated example values and must be re-cast to the legal form.
Unverified during this review: maximum namespace length, and the full Names API method set beyond names/create/namespace. Confirm against a node before finalising.
Successor draft to namespace.v0.1.0 (standards/namespace-standard.json), retained for history.
